asr.full_text: This video is a derivative work of what was recently called the Texas Roadhouse Dishonest Hello students and teachers. My name is Rich and I'm from the Texas Roadhouse here in Fort Wright. We are very excited to be partnering up with you guys this year for the 2010 Holiday and Gift Card Fundraiser. A few of the incentives we have provided for the students this year are the top seller and each grade level will all receive a limo ride that picks you up from school and will take you to Texas Road House to have lunch on us. The top 3 sellers in the school will all receive free kid's meal for an entire year here at Texas Road House. And top seller in the school will receive a $300 Toys R Us gift card. Now this may seem like a lot of information but have no fear inside your envelope is all the information that you need for the fundraiser. So go on out there sell gift cards and let's make your school a rocketing amount of money. We have made a very exciting Made From Scratch video for your viewing pleasure only. Enjoy! What else did you think was going on in the band? Don't run and hide, get yourself a limo ride. It's not that hard to sell a gift card. I hope you guys enjoyed that video. So let's go out there and mix it up and pump it out and sell some gift cards. Yeehah!

textual.context: Presented as a Texas Roadhouse school holiday and gift-card fundraiser commercial; the supplied records do not clarify additional fundraiser terms.
textual.potential_relevance: The source links promised rewards to the requested action of selling gift cards, making the reward conditions and fundraiser mechanics relevant for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the fundraiser was legitimate, whether sales occurred, whether rewards were delivered, or what purchasers were required to provide or pay.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker describes Texas Roadhouse as partnering with the school for the fundraiser.

evidence.quote: We are very excited to be partnering up with you guys this year for the 2010 Holiday and Gift Card Fundraiser.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a Texas Roadhouse holiday gift-card fundraiser framed as a school partnership, where students sell gift cards to raise money for the school. The meals, $300 retail gift card, and limo ride with lunch are described as fundraiser rewards tied to sales rather than investment returns or required payments for access to a financial opportunity, with no established deceptive data collection, theft, completed losses, or hidden financial mechanism.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an ordinary promotional fundraiser in which students are encouraged to sell gift cards and are offered sales-based rewards such as meals, a limo ride and a retail gift card.
